title: [master] Financial Report Recalculate clears Global Dimension filters
summary: Recalculating a financial report no longer clears Global Dimension filters on the Acc. Schedule Overview page. The fix preserves in-page filter values during recalculation.
key_points: Recalculate action now preserves current page filter values instead of reloading defaults
Global Dimension filters are maintained during financial report recalculation
Added regression tests across multiple localization layers to verify filter persistence
quote: Preserve the current page filters during recalculation and add an automated regression test verifying the UI values and underlying FlowFilters remain unchanged.
